metadata.scenario: A prospect calls to learn more about the home renovation services available and the timeline for projects. Category: New Inquiry. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, my name is David Anderson. I was referred by Dorothy Henderson. I'm looking for care services for my wife. Nice to meet you, David! I’m glad you called. What specific services are you interested in for your wife? Well, she recently had a stroke, so we need physical therapy and some nursing care as well. Of course, we can definitely help with that. We offer both physical therapy and skilled nursing care. Great! Can you tell me more about those services? Sure! Our physical therapy sessions run about 45 to 60 minutes and are priced between $110 and $140. It's focused on mobility and rehabilitation. That sounds helpful. What about the nursing care? Our skilled nursing care involves licensed nurses who can assist with medication management and health monitoring, priced at $95 to $125 for 1 to 2 hours. I see. How soon could we get someone started? We can typically schedule a care team within a few days, depending on availability. Would you prefer morning or afternoon visits? Morning would be better, around 10 AM if possible. I’ll note that preference down. Would you also like to discuss setting up a care plan? Yes, that would be important to figure out how to proceed. Perfect! Our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen, can assist you with the care plan and family communication. Would you like me to connect you with her? Yes, that would be helpful. Lisa is available Monday through Saturday. I can give you her direct line if you’d prefer to reach out to her. That would be great. What’s her number? Her direct number is +13165559203. Thank you! And what about insurance—will you assist with that? Yes, Lisa can help you navigate insurance authorization as well. Sounds good. I appreciate your help, Margaret. You're very welcome, David! Just to recap, I’ll schedule a physical therapy session and get you connected with Lisa for the care plan. Yes, please. I’ll follow up with you later today to confirm those details. Thank you so much! Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, David. Have a wonderful day! You too, bye!
